mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, main_id, name, code, effective_time, effective_time_unit, track_query_mode, paper_length, paper_width, sorting_code, fee_rule, max_customs_amount, max_customs_currency, min_customs_amount, min_customs_currency, max_weight, weight_unit, tax_model, is_ioss_prepay, is_api_sign, is_api_insurance,disabled,paper_size,source_id,source_type,sync_source_id,max_length,size_unit, max_width,max_height,declare_code_type,delivery_type,undeliverable_decision,is_platform_ship
mapper.select:
select lc.id, lc.code, lc.name, lc.disabled, ls.id as logisticsSupplierId, ls.supplier_name as supplierName from logistics_channel lc inner join logistics_supplier ls on lc.main_id = ls.id and ls.is_deleted = false where lc.is_deleted = false
and lc.main_id in
#{item}
and lc.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.name}::text,'%')
order by lc.disabled asc,lc.id desc

SELECT lc.id, lc.name, lc.code, lc.disabled FROM logistics_channel lc INNER JOIN logistics_supplier ls ON lc.main_id = ls.id and ls.is_deleted = false WHERE lc.is_deleted=false AND ls.supplier_id=#{supplierId}

SELECT lc.id, lc.name, lc.code, lc.disabled FROM logistics_channel_address lca INNER JOIN logistics_channel lc ON lca.logistics_channel_id = lc.id and lc.is_deleted = false WHERE lca.is_deleted=false AND lca.address_id=#{addressId}

select lc.id, lc.main_id, lc.name, lc.code from logistics_channel lc LEFT JOIN logistics_sale_channel lsc on lc.source_id = lsc.id where lc.is_deleted = false and lc.name = #{channelName} or lsc.cn_name = #{channelName}

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT lc.ID FROM logistics_channel lc INNER JOIN logistics_channel_remote_postcode lcrp ON lc.ID = lcrp.logistics_channel_id AND lcrp.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN remote_postcode rp ON rp.ID = lcrp.remote_postcode_id AND rp.is_deleted = FALSE AND rp.disabled = FALSE INNER JOIN remote_postcode_detail rpd ON rpd.main_id = rp.ID AND rpd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE lc.is_deleted = FALSE AND lc.ID = #{ logisticsChannelId } AND ( ( rpd.match_type = 'preciseMatch' AND rpd.country = #{ country } AND rpd.post_code = #{ postCode } ) OR ( rpd.match_type = 'prefixMatch' AND #{ postCode } LIKE concat ( rpd.post_code, '%' ) ) OR ( rpd.match_type = 'suffixMatch' AND #{ postCode } LIKE concat ( '%', rpd.post_code ) ) OR ( rpd.match_type = 'fuzzyMatch' AND #{ postCode } LIKE concat ( '%', rpd.post_code, '%' ) ) ) LIMIT 1 )

select ls.id, ls.supplier_name as name, ls.short_name as shortName, ls.type, lc.id as channelId, lc.name as channelName from logistics_supplier ls inner join logistics_channel lc on ls.id = lc.main_id and lc.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and ls.is_deleted = false and lc.disabled = false and ls.disabled = false
${params.permissionSql}

SELECT lcw.overseas_warehouse_id,lc.id,lc.name from logistics_channel lc inner join logistics_supplier ls on ls.id = lc.main_id inner join logistics_warehouse lcw on ls.id = lcw.main_id where lc.is_deleted = false and lcw.is_deleted = false and ls.is_deleted = false and lc.disabled = false order by lcw.overseas_warehouse_id

select la.logistics_platform as platformCode, lc.id as platformLogisticsChannelId, lc."name" as platformLogisticsChannelName from logistics_auth la LEFT JOIN logistics_supplier ls on ls.id = la.main_id and ls.is_deleted= false LEFT JOIN logistics_channel lc on lc.main_id = ls.id and lc.is_deleted= false where la.is_deleted = false and ls.auth_status='already' and lc.disabled = false and la.logistics_platform in
#{item}
